tasks.subject: Task 1: Fix Sentence Practice Translation Answers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Translation questions in Sentence Practice show Italian options when they should show English options (for IT→EN direction) and vice versa.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/api/sentences/generate/route.ts`
- Modify: `components/SentencePractice.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] IT→EN direction shows English answer choices for translation questions
- [ ] EN→IT direction shows Italian answer choices
- [ ] Stale cached rows are detected and regenerated
- [ ] TypeScript compiles with no errors

**Verify:** Open Sentence Practice IT→EN, translation question choices are English sentences.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/api/sentences/generate/route.ts", "components/SentencePractice.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["IT→EN translation questions show English choices", "EN→IT translation questions show Italian choices", "Stale cache detected and regenerated", "TypeScript compiles"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Add Word and Sentence Enrichment Modes to Translate API
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `/api/translate` handles `mode: 'word'` (article/gender/plural/grammarNote via Claude) and `mode: 'sentence'` (Italian + literalNote via Claude).

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/api/translate/route.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `mode: 'word'` returns `{ italian, article, gender, plural, grammarNote }`
- [ ] `mode: 'sentence'` returns `{ italian, literalNote }`
- [ ] Existing modes unaffected
- [ ] TypeScript compiles

**Verify:** `curl -X POST /api/translate -d '{"english":"backpack","mode":"word"}'` returns article/gender/plural.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/api/translate/route.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["word mode returns enriched metadata", "sentence mode returns literalNote", "existing translate and conjugations modes unaffected"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Build and Mount TranslatorWidget on Dashboard
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Quick Translate panel above the set grid on the home page. Words return article/gender/plural/note; sentences return Italian + literal structure note.

**Files:**
- Create: `components/TranslatorWidget.tsx`
- Modify: `app/home/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Widget visible above set grid on home dashboard
- [ ] Single word returns article, gender, plural, grammar note badges
- [ ] Multi-word phrase returns Italian + literal structure inset box
- [ ] 🔊 button plays Italian pronunciation
- [ ] Enter key submits, typing clears previous result
- [ ] TypeScript compiles

**Verify:** `npm run dev`, sign in, widget is above set cards. Test "backpack" and "She speaks quickly".

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/TranslatorWidget.tsx", "app/home/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Widget visible above set grid", "Word result shows badges", "Sentence result shows literal note", "TTS works", "TypeScript compiles"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Build Conjugation Flashcard Mode
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Sets with verb conjugation data get a Conjugations study mode that drills all 6 pronoun forms per verb as individual flashcards.

**Files:**
- Create: `components/ConjugationStudy.tsx`
- Create: `app/sets/[id]/conjugation/page.tsx`
- Modify: `app/sets/[id]/page.tsx`
- Modify: `components/StudyModePicker.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Sets with conjugation data show Conjugations in StudyModePicker
- [ ] Sets without conjugation data do not show it
- [ ] 6 cards per verb, shuffled, no progress saved to DB
- [ ] IT→EN: front shows "(io) ho" + verb label, back shows "I have"
- [ ] EN→IT: front shows "I have" + verb label, back shows "(io) ho" + speaker
- [ ] Space/arrow keyboard shortcuts work
- [ ] Session complete screen with score
- [ ] TypeScript compiles

**Verify:** Open a chapter set with verbs, StudyModePicker shows Conjugations. Click it, cards drill pronoun forms.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/ConjugationStudy.tsx", "app/sets/[id]/conjugation/page.tsx", "app/sets/[id]/page.tsx", "components/StudyModePicker.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Conjugations entry appears for sets with verb data", "Hidden for sets without verb data", "Cards drill pronoun forms correctly", "Both directions work", "Keyboard shortcuts work", "TypeScript compiles"]}
```
